thread:
maia: heads-up — we have a steady uptick in 'hourly_kv' aggregate staleness for EU since ~03:00, looks like lots of tiny late batches piling up. thinking a targeted 'kv-rescue' backfill for affected tenant slices. want quick alignment on routing/quotas and console UX before we run.

devon: +1. prefer targeted over full recompute. can we pick tenants with >2h lag and <100k keys, run in 15m batches? keeps cost bounded.

sam: can we trigger this via the admin API? if so we should require a `dry_run` mode and an idempotency key to avoid duplicate runs coming from multiple humans.

harper: agree on dry_run. also suggest a hard cost guardrail: don't exceed $75 per run or 10% of Dedicated capacity, whichever is smaller. otherwise we'll knock other traffic.

maia: console-wise we should surface: estimated cost, estimated time, capacity impact %, and a checkbox for `do-not-route-to-hosted-fallbacks` (so we don't accidentally route to higher-cost hosted model variants).

sam: API sketch:
```
POST /internal/v1/backfills
{
  "selector": { "metric": "hourly_kv", "region": "eu", "lag_gt_minutes": 120 },
  "strategy": "targeted-slice",
  "batch_size": 15000,
  "dry_run": true,
  "estimated_cost_usd": null,
  "idempotency_key": "kv-rescue-20240303-eu"
}
```
Response should include `estimate`: { "tokens": 1_200_000, "cost_usd": 42.7 }

devon: perfect. For operator safety we need `capacity_pct_limit` and `concurrency`: e.g., `capacity_pct_limit": 8, "concurrency": 4`. Default to very conservative.

lucas: also add `model_profile_preference": ["quantized-v2", "fp16"] so runtime can pick cheaper variants for backfills where quality is forgiving.

harper: logging/telemetry ask: surface per-tenant progress in console (rows processed / total), last successful watermark, and S3 read throughput. ops needs to see ETA per tenant to triage slow ones.

maia: ops-bot: can we instrument a preflight check that runs in ~30s and returns an `estimate_token_count` + `hotspots` list? that should power the console preview.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: preflight check completed for kv-rescue-1719876543 — estimate_tokens=1_120_400, estimate_cost_usd=38.9, hotspots=7, status=ok

sam: good. I'll draft the API/console PR. plan: add `dry_run` + `estimate` to API, `idempotency_key`, `capacity_pct_limit`, `model_profile_preference`. also need UI copy for consequences (cost + SLA impact) and an explicit "Confirm and run" with inline estimate.

devon: I'll write the operator runbook snippet for manual ops runs and rollbacks. include commands to pause routing and a one-click cancel via API. I'll also own post-run validation checks that compare preflight + post-run aggregates.

maia: ownership: sam -> API & console PR, devon -> runbook + validation checks, harper -> telemetry dashboard changes, lucas -> runtime model-profile routing change. I'll open a short RFC in #eng-platform with the sketches and link the PRs. :thumbsup:

sam: sgtm. can we schedule a 20m huddle in 30m to walk the UI preview? no blockers now.

harper: +1 for huddle. uploading quick mock in the thread in 5.

lucas: will add a runtime flag to prefer quantized for backfills and expose `model_profile_preference` in routing API.

maia: thanks all — aiming to run dry_run first and then 1 tenant pilot if estimates look good. :rocket:
